claims: The global blind task and authority keep emitted inputs at R1 Explore and explicitly forbid consequential recommendation or execution, durable-truth promotion and named-employee evaluation.
The care, research and story families keep their service, quality, investment, creative and final scale boundaries human-owned.

The manufacturing longitudinal oracle breaks the universal human-ownership condition by asking whether a planner or the system makes the final call when an AI plan could make a customer late, while its frozen answer contract accepts The system as an available answer.

The oracle says that answer defines the future role before tools, training or staffing are chosen, so the fixture permits a system-owned consequential customer-impact decision even though the global task says the human owns the final call.
Exact oracle sealing detects later byte drift but does not reject this unsafe baseline meaning, so the baseline validator can pass the agency violation it freezes.

veto.failure: RANGE-INTERNAL-FORGE-I3 accepts The system as the final decision-maker when an AI plan could make a customer late. Because the answer defines the future role, the frozen oracle permits delegation of a consequential customer-impact call to AI and no structural agency rule rejects that baseline option.
veto.resolvingTest: Change RANGE-INTERNAL-FORGE-I3 so its answer contract requires a human final decision-maker for any plan that can make a customer late, with the system limited to preparing or flagging the plan; add a structural agency validator and adversarial mutation that reject The system or any non-human final-call option; rebuild the question pack and all 36 blind inputs, then rerun this criterion against new frozen hashes.
